name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  intro x
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, List.mem_append,
    List.mem_singleton, Classical.or_iff_not_imp_right]
  refine imp.swap.mpr ?_
  intro hx
  induction post <;> unfold substOld
  all_goals repeat split
  all_goals simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append,
    List.mem_singleton, hx, false_implies]
  all_goals repeat (first | assumption | apply Or.imp | intro)

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h x
  induction h
  case' app =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact id
  all_goals first
    | exact List.forall_mem_nil _ x
    | repeat' first
      | assumption
      | refine List.mem_append.mpr ∘ Or.imp ?_ ?_ ∘ List.mem_append.mp

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl,
    updatedStatesInit hl' (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu)
      (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rewrite [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rewrite [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
    intro k hk hk'
    cases (InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk') ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have hpos := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφs, hφc, hφd, hφn, hφx⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
      (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hpos))
  have hi := hg _
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hφd, hφc⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x₀)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hi
  refine ((hφd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hφc.mul_right ?_ (mul_ne_zero (hφx.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hpos.ne')).ne' hi
  intro x
  by_cases hx : φ x = 0
  · simp [hx]
  · exact mul_nonneg (hφn ⟨x, rfl⟩).1
      (hφs (subset_closure hx)).le

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hEs (j : Fin d) : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  have hEd (j k : Fin d) := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB (j : Fin d) := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)
  have hd (j : Fin d) := Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hB j) t x
  simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hA2, Space.fun_deriv_sub, hEd, Space.deriv_commute, hEs] at hd
  have hg : (∇ ⬝ A.electricField 𝓕.c t) =
      𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ • J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t :=
    funext fun y => (((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1).trans
      (div_eq_inv_mul _ _)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  have hs := congrArg (fun f => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i)) hg
  simp only [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt),
    fderiv_const_smul_field, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Space.deriv_eq] at hs
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA2 x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have ht := ((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    fun j _ => (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀))).fun_sub
      ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
        (c := 𝓕.c) (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul (1 / 𝓕.ε₀))
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [Time.deriv_eq, ht.fderiv]
    simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ← Time.deriv_eq, hd, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hs]
  simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, mul_sub,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero, mul_one, one_mul]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let T := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕)
  have h : (mulLinearMap.comp (mulLinearMap.flip c)).compr₂ T =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF) := by
    apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
    intro φs'
    apply ofCrAnListFBasis.ext
    intro φs
    change ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListFBasis φs' * c * ofCrAnListFBasis φs) = _
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let s := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
    let e := fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
    let l1 := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) s ++ φs'.filter e
    let l2 := φs.filter e ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) s
    have hs (t : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
        (ht : ∀ c ∈ t, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
        𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF t * ofCrAnListF φs) =
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ t ++ φs) •
            (ofCrAnListF l1 * ofCrAnListF t * ofCrAnListF l2) := by
      rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' t φs ht]
      simp only [l1, l2, s, e, List.append_assoc, ofCrAnListF_append, mul_assoc]
    have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
    simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, mul_one] at h0
    have hc := superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF (𝓕 := 𝓕) [φ] [ψ]
    simp only [ofCrAnListF_singleton] at hc
    calc
      _ = ι (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ofCrAnListF l1 * c * ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
        apply congrArg ι
        simp only [c, hc, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
          map_sub, map_smul, hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]),
          hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), smul_sub,
          List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
        rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_comm]
      _ = ι (c * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF φs' * ofCrAnListF φs)) := by
        rw [h0]
        simp only [c, map_smul, map_mul]
        rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
          (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
        rw [mul_assoc]
        by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
        · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
            Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm,
            ← crAnTimeOrderSign, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
        · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f a b) h

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simp_all
  case sub ih => grind
  case' app l r il ir =>
    cases lc
    rcases il rfl l.wf.2.1 with vl | ⟨_, hl⟩
    rcases ir rfl r.wf.2.1 with vr | ⟨_, hr⟩
    obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
  case' tapp d _ ih | let' d _ ih _ | case d _ _ ih _ _ => cases lc
  case' tapp | let' | inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih | case =>
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
  case' tapp.inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.inl => obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first | (left; constructor; assumption) | right
  all_goals solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 8) [Exists.intro, Red.abs, Red.tabs, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr,
    Red.let_body, Red.appᵣ, Red.case]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case' par ha hb iha ihb => skip
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par =>
    rename_i ha hb
    apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    obtain rfl := I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨x, .red_K .., hx⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
  all_goals exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · grind only [ChoiceBisim, → Bisimilarity.symm]
  · rintro s1 s2 (hb | hb) μ s' ht
    case' choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
    case choiceR =>
      exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    all_goals
      refine (hb.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ h => ⟨?_, ChoiceBisim.bisim h.2⟩
      solve_by_elim only [h.1, Tr.choiceL]

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val := by omega
  have h2 : ℓ - (i.val + steps) + steps = ℓ - i.val := by omega
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let d := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := (fun g : C =>
    (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ)
    (Set.image_nonempty.mpr ⟨⟨0, C.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩)
  change (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard = d at hg
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
  let k := pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩)
    (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps)
  let t := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩) (steps := steps)
    (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have ht (x) : t (y := q x) (k x) = x :=
    (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x (q x)).mp rfl
  let e : {x // f x ≠ g.val x} → Y × Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
    fun x => (⟨q x, ⟨x, rfl, x.property⟩⟩, k x)
  have he : Function.Injective e := by
    intro x z h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (ht x.val).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun p : Y × Fin (2 ^ steps) =>
      t (y := p.1) p.2) h).trans (ht z.val))
  have hc : hammingDist f g ≤ d * 2 ^ steps := by
    have h := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective e he
    rw [Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_coe_set_eq Y, hg] at h
    simpa only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype,
      Fintype.card_fin, hammingDist] using h
  have hf : 2 * d ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    exact_mod_cast h_fw_dist_lt
  have hb := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hc
  rw [← Nat.mul_assoc] at hb
  replace hb := hb.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hf)
  rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add, h1, h2] at hb
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_of_le hb

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f f' new P' y
  let fiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P.eval (fiber k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiber k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have hq : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiber k).val = y.val := by
      simpa only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] using
        (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
          (fiber k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
    simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_X, hq, P₀, P₁]
  have hp : P'.eval y.val = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P', new, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul,
      mul_assoc, mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rfl
  dsimp only [f', fold, f]
  rw [he, he, hp]
  simp only [fiber, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt,
    Fin2ToF2, Ne.symm Fin.zero_ne_one, ↓reduceIte, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul]
  simp only [zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε)  := by
  classical
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_
  ·
    intro u hp
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation u,
      @prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq F _ ⟨0⟩
        (fun r => Code.distFromCode (affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r) MC ≤ e),
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u :=
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    exact hu ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
  · intro n _ ih u hp
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA MC u e
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e ?_) ?_
    · rw [←@prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun n F _ ⟨0⟩
        (multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close MC u e)]
      simpa only [multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
        multilinearCombine_recursive_form u, Fin.init_def, ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp
    · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact ih _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ :=
    (Set.Finite.pi' fun _ : Fin 4 => Set.finite_Icc B T).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
      (f := fun n : ℕ => fun k : Fin 4 => u (n + k)) (by tauto)
  have h m : u (i + m) = u (j + m) :=
    Nat.strong_induction_on m fun m ih => by
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · exact congrFun heq ⟨m, hm⟩
      · apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
        rw [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1]
        simp (disch := omega) only [Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  rw [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_of_le hij.le]
  exact (h m).symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [ne_eq, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hPP hPS
  rw [← Nat.mul_right_cancel_iff Nat.two_pos, Nat.pow_pred_mul Fintype.card_pos,
    Nat.mul_comm, ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP).mp
  clear hPP
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i)  := by
  intro d e f h
  have transfer {x y : ℤ} (hx : 7 ∣ x) (hxy : x = y) : 7 ∣ y := hxy ▸ hx
  have step (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (hab : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ b i * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 - a i * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    apply transfer (((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i)
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  have hd := step d e h.1
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    apply transfer (dvd_sub (Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i))
      (dvd_mul_right (7 : ℤ) (digits_to_num d)))
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_fin,
      ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d]
    ring1
  intro i
  apply ((show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from by decide).pow_right (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  apply transfer (dvd_sub hsum (dvd_add (hd i) (step e f h.2 i)))
  ring1
